description: This file defines the RitaApi class, which provides methods for constructing, sending, and processing API requests to a third-party service, including handling request/response fields, HTTP communication, and validation.

classes.name: RitaApi
classes.description: A class for managing API requests and responses to a third-party service, including setting parameters, sending requests over HTTP, and parsing responses.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a parameter value in the API request after validating and converting the input.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified parameter from the API request.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the current request parameters.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Returns the internal map of request parameters.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends the API request over HTTP and processes the response, returning a new RitaApi instance with response data.
